metrics.definition: Pass events with provider goal_assist flag; no inferred assists.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Ball Recovery events without recovery_failure.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Provider Carry events. Not every touch or dribble attempt.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Pass events with absent pass.outcome (provider success encoding).
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Completed open-play pass or carry from outside to inside x>=102, 18<=y<=62.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Shot outcome Goal, periods 1–4; excludes own goals and shootouts.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Interception events; outcomes retained in canonical events, not assumed successful.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Pass with shot_assist or goal_assist. Includes goal-creating passes.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Goals excluding Shot type Penalty.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Sum of provider xG excluding penalties; null if any applicable shot lacks xG.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: 100 * completed passes / attempted passes. Null for zero attempts.
metrics.denominator: All attempted passes

metrics.definition: Completed open-play pass starts x<80 and ends x>=80 on provider 120x80 pitch.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: All Pass events, including restarts.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Provider Pressure events; not successful presses. Null if a whole match has no pressure coverage.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Carry with same distance-to-goal rule as progressive passes.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Completed open-play pass: forward and reduces distance to goal centre by >=10m AND >=25%. Coordinates scaled to 105x68m. Restarts excluded.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Shot events in periods 1–4, including penalties.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Duel events with subtype Tackle; attempted, not necessarily won.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Dispossessed + Miscontrol events only. Excludes failed passes; not all possession losses.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Sum of linked assisted shot xG; requires same match/team and valid shot link. Not a pass-based xA model.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

metrics.definition: Sum of provider statsbomb_xg over shots; null if any shot lacks xG.
metrics.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

cohort.method: Empirical midrank; same dataset, competition, season, gender and dominant position

evidence.confidence_method: 100 × min(minutes/900,1) × sum(min(metric observations/30,1) for observed benchmarked metrics) / all profile metrics. Each metric needs 10 reference observations. Not a probability or quality score.
